description: This file contains utility functions and classes for managing execution of shell commands, including process spawning, environment sanitization, output handling, and system event notifications within a shell or terminal environment.

methods.name: detectCursorKeyMode
methods.description: Detects cursor key mode ('application' or 'normal') from PTY output chunk based on last toggle sequence.

methods.name: sanitizeHostBaseEnv
methods.description: Sanitizes environment variables by removing dangerous variables and preserving PATH.

methods.name: validateHostEnv
methods.description: Validates environment variables for security, throwing errors if dangerous variables or PATH modifications are detected.

methods.name: resolveExecTarget
methods.description: Resolves the effective execution target (host) based on configuration, request, and sandbox availability.

methods.name: normalizeNotifyOutput
methods.description: Normalizes output string for notifications by trimming and replacing whitespace.

methods.name: compactNotifyOutput
methods.description: Truncates and normalizes notification output to a maximum character length.

methods.name: applyShellPath
methods.description: Prepends specified paths to the environment's PATH variable.

methods.name: maybeNotifyOnExit
methods.description: Sends system event notification upon process exit if conditions are met.

methods.name: createApprovalSlug
methods.description: Creates a short slug from an approval ID.

methods.name: buildApprovalPendingMessage
methods.description: Constructs a message requesting approval for command execution with details.

methods.name: resolveApprovalRunningNoticeMs
methods.description: Determines the delay in milliseconds for approval running notices, with default fallback.

methods.name: emitExecSystemEvent
methods.description: Enqueues a system event related to execution activity and triggers heartbeat wake.

methods.name: joinExecFailureOutput
methods.description: Concatenates aggregated output with failure reason for error reporting.

methods.name: classifyExecFailureKind
methods.description: Classifies the reason for process failure based on exit reason, code, signal, and error type.

methods.name: formatExecFailureReason
methods.description: Generates human-readable message explaining process failure reason.

methods.name: buildExecExitOutcome
methods.description: Builds outcome object for a process that has exited, indicating success or failure.

methods.name: buildExecRuntimeErrorOutcome
methods.description: Builds outcome object for a process that encountered a runtime error.

methods.name: runExecProcess
methods.description: Main function to spawn and manage execution of a shell command, handling environment, PTY, sandboxing, output, and process lifecycle.
